ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid high-intensity white contiguous field covering the central 80% of both lobes. Irregular low-intensity black banding (5-20 pixel depth) along the superior trailing edge. Sparse, low-density black mottling concentrated near the median notch and lower lobe margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 70-degree vertex angle and a depth of 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration. Multiple jagged peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-15 pixels) distributed continuously along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of textured, high-contrast light pixels located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, corresponding to localized surface disruption.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical linear dark mark (approx. 40 pixels in length) on the inner-right lobe. Faint, unaligned horizontal scratches visible on the lower-left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged tissue loss and irregular profile along the superior trailing edge; dense barnacle colonization clusters on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark, circular pigment spot located in the mid-right interior lobe field.
